item.title: How the Claude Code team does code review
item.description: As merges to Anthropic's monorepo grew from about 2,500 to more than 30,000 a day, source control became the biggest development bottleneck. Here is how the team built Scion, an in-house version control system designed for always-online agents, and migrated off git in five months.
